All checks passed.

critical_code_review_comments: widget/chat.js: on the final step, if the fetch fails the widget sets idx = steps.length - 1 which puts the user back on 'location' — resubmission may still fail because payload lacks contact/name updates. Minor UX resilience concern, not blocking.
widget/chat.js: 'Skip' chip for budget submits '' but no visual user bubble appears (submit early-returns on empty val). That is intentional but could confuse users; consider echoing 'Skipped'.

widget/chat.js: input.focus() on open panel works but on the 'looking'/'budget' quick-reply steps, typing into the input still calls submit(v) which will fail validation only for the current step (contact). For chip-only steps a free-text reply is accepted as the answer — acceptable per scripted design but worth noting.
